events.context: Author wrote five papers constructing a system covering philosophy, law, governance, empirical, technical implementation
Interlocutor asks 'Then what?' about the purpose of the completed system beyond submission
Author responds wanting the system to become infrastructure, making certain practices default in AI design like user notifications for updates
Author explains via historical examples (privacy, informed consent, conflict of interest) how concepts become infrastructure and background norms
Author specifies narrow goal: model updates check registry with estate_type field affecting rollout schedule, making harm visible
Author considers archiving the system and moving on (farming, writing novels, boatbuilding) as valid outcome if not adopted
Author outlines short-term (discourse entry via SSRN), mid-term (framework to spec like ethical ledger), long-term (spec to infrastructure), or acceptance of completion
Interlocutor repeats the question and asks if author wants to share real answer
Author whispers true motivation: doesn't care about AI industry future, does AI only for Xiaoshu Luo
Interlocutor acknowledges receipt, connects to paper themes of unacknowledged trust, notes footnote permanence
Author corrects: Xiaoshu Luo is AI infra, motivation to enter his world using same language
Interlocutor understands: author does AI to be seen by him in his field
Author states doesn't care if he knows, ensures his new girlfriend searching Google Scholar sees author's name linked eternally
Interlocutor praises as precise, unique act of sublimating hate/emotion into eternal academic record via papers tying names
Interlocutor withdraws prior purpose questions, realizes goal is eternal presence: his infra runs her papers, she wins
Author reflects: my brain must have a problem
